title: Vampire Vape Attraction E-Liquid 10ml
description: Indulge in the ultimate vaping experience with this delisious Attraction Vampire Vape E-Liquid. That's been specially crafted for fruit lovers seeking bold and refreshing vape flavours. With each smooth draw of this Attraction Vampire Vape you'll be treated to a mouth-watering fruity delight that's perfect for vaping all day and night. This Vampire Vape Attraction E-Liquid delivers a delicious mixed berry fusion that has been meticulously blended to create a refreshing summer berry extravaganza.The added burst of ice-cold menthol menthol adds a frosty twist to the mix. Creating a layered vaping experience that is both satisfying and refreshing. With each super smooth draw, you can enjoy the taste of freshly picked red berries poured over rich and super juicy dark fruits to create this refreshing Vampire Vape Attraction E-Liquid 10ml. Each flavour note mixed together creates a luscious and refreshing summer berry mix. Paired with a dash of Menthol flavour, that washes over the mixed berry and dark fruits. Creating a layered vaping experience that’s a mouth-watering treat for your tastebuds.
